Subject: POC prompt dataset collection & eval plan - AcmeCorp

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the POC so we can get the eval running next week:

1) Success criteria (what you told us):
   - 90%+ helpfulness on customer support triage prompts (same categories you shared)
   - <= 2x latency relative to your SLA target (95th pct under 220ms) for 256-token outputs
   - No PII leakage in generated outputs (we'll run privacy checks)

2) What we need from you to start:
   - A representative set of prompts (300-500) and typical user inputs/logs — you mentioned a sanitized sample from the past 30 days.
   - The priority categories/labels for evaluation (e.g., billing, technical, onboarding)
   - Contact and owner on your side for dataset questions (we discussed Samantha as owner).

3) Redwood deliverables and timeline (proposed):
   - By Aug 19 (T+1): We’ll share a short POC eval plan doc with metrics and evaluation script (link below).
   - By Aug 23 (T+5): You provide sample prompts + redacted logs.
   - Aug 24-27: We run initial model runs and quality checks.
   - Aug 30: Demo + review of results and next steps.

4) Data handling / security notes:
   - Please redact any PII before sending. If you need, we can provide a redaction checklist.
   - We will only use uploaded data for this POC and delete after 60 days unless you instruct otherwise.

Attachments: poc-eval-plan-v1.docx (DOCX, 120KB) — this is the evaluation plan draft.

Could you confirm owners and whether Aug 23 works for sample submission? If helpful, attach the sample CSV directly in reply or share a Drive link.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Alex / Samantha —

Thanks, that looks like the right format. A couple quick follow-ups before you upload the full export:

- Could you confirm the label taxonomy (exact category strings) in the mapping doc so our eval script maps labels correctly?
- Please include a short sample of negative examples (cases where the agent answered incorrectly) if possible — helps calibrate thresholds.
- For logs: redaction guidance: remove or hash user emails, phone numbers, full names; keep ticket IDs and timestamps. If you can’t redact certain fields, flag them so we can discuss scoping.

I've attached the eval plan link again and added a small checklist for the CSV columns we expect. Priyom will own the evaluation runs from our side; Neha will handle data ingestion/security checks.

Next steps (action owners):
- Alex / Samantha: Upload full prompts CSV + redacted logs to Drive by Aug 23 (owner: Samantha).
- Priyom (Redwood): Run initial eval and send results by Aug 27.
- Neha (Redwood): Complete security review of uploaded artifacts within 48 hours of upload.
- Marissa: Schedule Aug 30 review/demo (calendar invite to follow).

If that timeline still works, I'll send the calendar invite this afternoon.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Marissa
